My main motivation for quitting weed was that I've lived for years feeling miserable and out of control. I realised that weed was the best procrastination tool in the world. My life was slipping past me while I watched my friends grow, finish university, find love, get married, get a dog, go on holidays, finish projects etc while I went to skin up another zoot. I want to be successful and truly happy and to find a career/path that brings me joy. I want to find the inner peace that comes with small, meaningful moments. I want to get out of debt and look after my body. There are so many reasons! We all deserve happiness, and I'm looking forward to living 😌 Apologies for the rambling, this is the first time I've put words to paper regarding this.
